exposure: Complete Hydatidiform Moles Coexisting with a Fetus (CHMCF)
cohort: The study included 14 patients diagnosed with Complete Hydatidiform Moles Coexisting with a Fetus (CHMCF) treated at a single hospital in Japan between 2000 and 2020.
finding: The study found a higher occurrence of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) after CHMCF compared to typical complete hydatidiform moles, although some patients who maintained their pregnancies successfully delivered live babies despite the heightened risk of premature birth.
mod_finding: Two live births occurred via emergency cesarean section.
